description: This file defines multiple Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) used for the domain models in a Java-based web application, including classes for project management, contractors, tenders, contracts, milestones, inspections, handovers, funds, payments, and notifications. It uses annotations for validation and schema descriptions, indicating its role in API request/response modeling.

classes.name: PageRequest
classes.description: DTO for pagination request parameters, including page index and size.

classes.name: ProjectCreate
classes.description: DTO for creating a new project with details such as code, name, description, dates, budget, and location coordinates.

classes.name: ProjectUpdate
classes.description: DTO for updating existing project information, including optional fields.

classes.name: ContractorCreate
classes.description: DTO for creating a new contractor with fields like name, contact, email, and address.

classes.name: ContractorUpdate
classes.description: DTO for updating contractor details including contact info and status.

classes.name: TenderCreate
classes.description: DTO for creating a tender with project association, number, dates, and estimated cost.

classes.name: TenderUpdate
classes.description: DTO for updating tender details like dates, cost, and status.

classes.name: ContractCreate
classes.description: DTO for creating a contract with linked project, contractor, contract number, dates, and value.

classes.name: ContractUpdate
classes.description: DTO for updating contract details including dates, value, and status.

classes.name: MilestoneCreate
classes.description: DTO for creating a milestone with project association, name, description, planned date, and amount.

classes.name: MilestoneUpdate
classes.description: DTO for updating milestone details including name, description, dates, amounts, and progress.

classes.name: MilestoneProgressUpdate
classes.description: DTO for updating milestone progress, including optional geotag and location note.

classes.name: InspectionCreate
classes.description: DTO for recording an inspection with location, date, inspector info, remarks, and status.

classes.name: HandoverCreate
classes.description: DTO for recording project handovers with date, recipient, and notes.

classes.name: FundCreate
classes.description: DTO for fund-related actions with project link, amount, type, and reference.

classes.name: PaymentCreate
classes.description: DTO for creating a payment entry with linked project, contract, milestone, amount, and method.

classes.name: PaymentUpdateStatus
classes.description: DTO for updating payment status with predefined status values.

classes.name: NotificationCreate
classes.description: DTO for creating a notification message for users.
